name: Kiss of Death
source:
As the daughter of a powerful crime family, loyalty is everything. But when you fall for the heir of a rival family, you must fight for love and life.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Kiss_of_Death]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
作为强大犯罪家族的女儿，忠诚就是一切。但当你爱上敌对家族的继承人时，你必须为爱情和生命而战。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Kiss_of_Death]Choices Wikia[/url]]
